players.product: The Generate Platform (machine-learning generative biology; computational design integrated with large-scale biological experimentation) and AI-engineered protein therapeutics such as GB-0895

quarterly_data.signal: Generate's 10-Q segment expense table: external research and development costs for GB-0895 were $20,490 thousand in Q2 2026 versus $13,280 thousand in Q2 2025 ($36,076 thousand vs $17,074 thousand in the first six months), while external discovery-related and other costs were $16,879 thousand versus $21,122 thousand ($33,337 thousand vs $40,292 thousand in the six months).
quarterly_data.figure: GB-0895 external R&D $20,490 thousand in Q2 2026 (Q2 2025: $13,280 thousand)

quarterly_data.signal: WuXi Biologics (supplier): Generate's 10-Q states that neither WuXi Biologics (Cayman) Inc., currently its sole provider of drug product for GB-4362, nor Lonza AG, its sole provider of drug product for GB-0895, is currently on the DoD 1260H list or otherwise designated a biotechnology company of concern, but that an affiliate of WuXi was recently added to the DoD 1260H list; Generate says that if WuXi, Lonza or other suppliers stopped supplying it, or it were prevented or restricted from using their services, it could experience delays in its studies and trials while it identifies and qualifies replacement suppliers.
